description: KanaDojo is an aesthetic, community-made platform for learning Japanese inspired by Duolingo and Monkeytype.
instructions: To begin, pick a dojo below and start training now!
kanaHeader: Welcome to the kana (hiragana and katakana) dojo!
kanaDescription: This is the place where you can learn and practice the two core syllabaries of Japanese - Hiragana and Katakana.
kanaInstructions: To begin, select at least 1 set of characters, select or change the training mode, then hit Go! below and start training now!
kanjiDescription: This is the place where you can learn and practice the main component of the Japanese writing system - the kanji characters.
kanjiInstructions: To begin, select at least 1 level, select your training mode, then hit Go! below and start training!
kanjiNew: New: click on a kanji character to find out more about it on Kanji Heatmap!
vocabularyDescription: This is the place where you can learn and practice the most common words used in day-to-day Japanese.
vocabularyInstructions: To begin, select at least 1 level, select your training mode, then hit Go! below and start training!
vocabularyNew: New: click on a word to find out more about it on Jisho!
